wiki.title: Lena Gonzalez
wiki.extract: Lena Adriana Gonzalez (born January 26, 1981) is an American politician serving as a member of the California State Senate from the 33rd district, which encompasses the Southeast Los Angeles area including Lakewood and Long Beach. From February 2024 to December 2025, she served as Majority Leader of the Senate.
